title: Elite Force SP visible player snapshots and client map startup

provenance.referenceLicense: STEF Game Source License; incompatible for GPL implementation incorporation
provenance.use: Behavioral observations only; no external implementation text or executable bytes incorporated
sourceObservations: cgame/cg_players.cpp:3181-3185 shared legs/torso animation frame updates
game/bg_pmove.cpp:1841 weapon-change effect uses torso animation
game/Q3_Interface.cpp:3420-3491 scripted weapon grants and client selection

safety.homes: Independent writable homes; original installation unchanged
safety.input: Mouse and joystick disabled; no input control/capture/injection
safety.display: Windowed inactive private Windows desktops or private Linux Xvfb
safety.cleanup: Diagnostic copies and logs retained in designated test/project areas

fixtureInventory.selection: All supplied maps/*.bsp excluding hm_* and ctf_*; each has info_player_start; case-insensitive sorted pak precedence.

platforms.windows: Windows x86, MSVC 19.44.35222; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU; GLx/Vulkan/RTX raster
platforms.linux: Ubuntu 24.04.3 WSL, i686 GCC 13.3, Clang 18.1.3; Mesa software OpenGL on private Xvfb
platforms.runtimeScope: SP Windows x86 only; Linux Holomatch control

correction: Do not premark the local player as already sent for STVEF SP; linked/NOCLIENT/PVS/area/portal filters still apply. All other profiles retain suppression.

before.reason: Expected SP visible player membership failed

windowsSuite.note: Full suite after source correction, before canonical client relink; new source regression included. Private corrected and canonical binaries are separately runtime-tested.

traceValidity.v1: Invalid snapshot output pointer at return; zero-valued snapshots discarded. Command-value observations separate.
traceValidity.v2: Snapshot logging moved immediately after playerstate copy; valid playerstate fields.
traceValidity.v3: Adds native source-ring entity count and first entity; valid snapshot fields.
traceValidity.instrumentation: Owned logging in independent retail test copies preserves registers/flags, replays displaced instructions and leaves original installation unchanged.

observations.thirdPerson: Retail and corrected GLx/Vulkan/RTX render the tutorial player; baseline GLx omits it. Canonical production reruns confirm the restoration.
observations.weaponSelection: Camelot selects grenade launcher 6 after correction, matching retail; baseline selects stasis weapon 5. Images also show corrected weapon choices on borg3, _holodeck_temple, scav2 and voy8.
observations.openTiming: At snapshot time1900 corrected playerstate.weapon is6, retail is2; at2150 both are6. Event sequence/order and startup weapon-change timing remain different.

comparisons.interpretation: Whole-frame RGB differences include random actors/combat, camera and event timing; no universal numerical parity threshold asserted. All samples retained.

manualStage.acceptance: Physical input, menu save/load and rebinding, listening, force-feedback hardware and campaign-wide acceptance remain pending. The adjusted capture script aligns displayed snapshot times; packet identifiers differ and broader retail image parity remains open.
manualStage.waveUpdate: Updated engine artifacts only; existing manual profiles and launchers retained. Physical input and listening remain pending.
manualStage.feedbackUpdate: Verified engine artifacts refreshed; homes preserved. Installed FFC10 copied to independent test assets. Launch-SP defaults use_ff to 0; optional user-operated checks documented.
